title: ever MARA|Embellished Tulle Midi Junior Bridesmaid Dress with Sheer Sleeves
descriptionHtml:
Featuring a delicate round neckline and sheer short sleeves, this tulle midi dress is adorned with shimmering embellishments that catch the light beautifully. A flattering satin waistband cinches the silhouette, offering both comfort and sophistication. Perfect for a junior bridesmaid.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises tulle&lace.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
